marker.description: Green-headed pin inserted into the lateral aspect of the cerebral hemisphere, likely indicating the lateral ventricle or adjacent white matter.

main_question: Identify the structure indicated by the green pin.
main_explanation: The pin is inserted into the cavity of the lateral ventricle, which is the largest of the four ventricles in the brain.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following structures is located medial to the structure indicated by the green pin?
supporting_question.explanation: The corpus callosum is the large white matter tract that connects the two cerebral hemispheres and forms the roof of the lateral ventricles.
